common.excluded: Raw OpenFOAM fields, volume meshes, solver binaries, processor directories, and experimental transmission-flux results are not part of this secondary-data deposit.

homogeneous.status: archived single-phase results; area choice is algebraically inactive
homogeneous.norm: Cell-volume-weighted combined complex pressure and velocity L2; job explicitly writes cell volumes before postprocessing.
homogeneous.boundary_diagnostic: Separate prior mesh deformation with no orthogonal boundary layer; supports the diagnostic orders only.

layered.status: selected geometric method; compared against independently frozen original executable
layered.reverse: Swap material ordering, retaining geometry/excitation/PML settings.
layered.sampling: VTK cell-to-point conversion and linear line probing at 1200 points including endpoints; all probe flags valid.
layered.reported_norm: Uniform sample-weighted combined complex-pressure L2 over the entire domain including PML.
layered.comparison_norm: Relative cell-centre L2 difference from the original serial field; uniform cells.
layered.matrix_residual: True assembled relative residual <=1e-10 for the instrumented selected solver. Empty baseline residuals mean unreported, not zero.

sphere.status: controlled comparison with the previous pressure flux for both area choices
sphere.reference: 25 angular orders, 0 through 24; regular spherical Bessel interior and outgoing Hankel exterior; pressure and inverse-density derivative continuity.
sphere.outer_boundary: Exact total-pressure Dirichlet data, no PML
sphere.pressure_norm: Volume-weighted complex-pressure L2. Cartesian cells have equal volumes.
sphere.parallel_difference: Eight-rank field mapped to the serial ordering, divided by serial field L2 for the same area method.
sphere.cost_note: Matrix entries and factor memory from the recorded eight-rank solve; single timing, not a scaling study.

piston.status: archived single-phase results; area choice is algebraically inactive
piston.near_norm: Relative L2/Linf of pressure magnitudes normalized by rho*c*u0; uniform sample weights.
piston.far_norm: Relative L2 of pressure magnitudes over 0 to 90 degrees; not relative SPL error.
piston.polar_display: Mirror the sampled 0..90 degree SPL about zero and subtract each curve maximum; radial display range -40..0 dB.
piston.SPL_definition: 10*log10(0.5*|P|^2/p_ref^2); RMS pressure from the complex peak amplitude.

gorkov.status: archived integrated-force secondary data reprocessed in job 54501044; no new solver rerun
gorkov.force_unit: N in CSV; multiply by 1e15 for fN in figures.
gorkov.peak_normalization: Position error normalized by the peak analytical force; well-defined at analytical zero crossings.
gorkov.limitations: Original full fields and binaries of the force sweeps are not recovered. Provenance reaches the archived integrated forces and their original postprocessing.
